about: Per sample, per property: the least share of elements that must match the source program's drawing in what graphty-element draws (test/browser/fidelity-scorecard.test.ts, CI's browser shards, SwiftShader). Floors only rise; a floor lowered by hand, or set for a newly judged property, is listed in lowered with why and when; record them with GRAPHTY_FIDELITY_RECORD=1.

allowedDrops.json-graphology-synth/fontSize: sigma draws every label 12 px on screen at every zoom, and graphty-element now does too (issue #3106); graphty-element frames this file about 1.27x further out than sigma, which fits node centers with 30 px padding and lets big nodes run off the canvas (issue #5367), so a 12 px label scores 15.18 against the 12 px reference; it returns to 1 when #5367 frames a sigma file as sigma does
